description: Return the current account tier, per-tool-group usage, rate limits, the search filters and country-code TLDs the tier can use, and stateful Monitor and Strategy quotas.
name: usage

tools.description: Usage and quota information grouped by tools that share a limit.

cctld.description: Country-code TLDs this tier can see, per tool: a list of codes, 'all' when the plan does not narrow them, or {"all_except": [codes]} when every country-code TLD except those codes is included. A two-letter code also covers its second-level suffixes ('br' includes 'com.br'). An empty list means country-code TLDs are not included on this tier. Generic TLDs are not narrowed by plan.

cost_per_call.description: Present when one call can use more than one unit of the daily limit; states how a call is counted.

filters.description: Filters this tier can use, per tool: a list of parameter names, or 'all' for every filter the tool offers. An empty list means filters are not supported on this tier. Filters outside the list are ignored and named in filter_notice.

upgrade_hint.description: Optional account-capacity information for tiers that have an upgrade path.

title: Usage and Quota
